 Persebaya Surabaya defeated Western Australia
 15th November 2026 22:26 GMT+7
 Persebaya Surabaya footballer Alex Martins (left) scored a goal against Western Australia goalkeeper Sam Reilly (right) in an international friendly match at Gelora Bung Tomo Stadium, Surabaya, East Java, Sunday (15/11/2026). Persebaya Surabaya won with a score of 4-3 over Western Australia. ANTARA FOTO/Rizal Hanafi/kye
